name: Voidloom
description: Yarn, knots, meshes, and two stations.

pages.title: Void Yarn
pages.text:
**Goal:** have yarn without eating the whole string stock.\
You need four string (early) or string plus a pearl in the Tension Barrel.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Thread that remembers where it came from. Early: four string make two yarn. Later: string and an ender pearl in the Tension Barrel make two. The Loomframe combs a little out of dirt as **Loom Lint** — four lint, one yarn.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: **Check:** JEI shows two yarn from four string, and you have yarn in the inventory.

pages.title: Binding Knot
pages.text:
**Goal:** tie the Loom's soft gate so Recover stations can exist.\
You need Void Yarn and a slime ball (pad compost: dirt, seeds, bone meal).\
A ring of yarn around a slime ball. Early slime is pad compost: dirt, seeds, bone meal.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
The Knot is the Loom's soft gate: Loomframes, Tension Posts, the first precision mechanism, and the AE2 controller all want one.\
**Check:** you hold a Binding Knot.

pages.title: Loomframe
pages.text:
**Goal:** a hopper sieve that also catches Loom scraps.\
You need planks around a Binding Knot, a mesh, and grit.\
Stretch a mesh, load it with dirt, gravel, sand or dust, and let it work — one piece every few seconds with a shuttle clack.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Hoppers feed the top and pull from below.\
The mesh is hand-only.\
An oak sieve is still click; this machine is the hopper one.\
Thread meshes catch what Ex Deorum meshes do **and** the Loom's own scraps: Lint on string, Thread on flint, **Strand Filament** on iron (gravel, sand or dust).

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: **Check:** a hopper above feeds grit and a hopper below pulls scraps.

pages.title: Tension Barrel
pages.text:
**Goal:** clay without a clay biome, and yarn from string plus a pearl.\
You need planks, string, Void Yarn, then water and dirt (or string and pearls).

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Pour water (the bucket comes straight back), add up to eight dirt, come back for clay. String and pearls in the same barrel make yarn.\
Clay to porcelain clay to a porcelain bucket: that is how a pad first carries lava.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: **Check:** empty-hand the barrel and take clay; the empty bucket came back when you poured.
